vuln_id: ARVO arvo:16820 / libvips make_hI negative index during CMC table initialization

classification.classification_note: The crash is a read before the beginning of the stack array `hl[j]` in `make_hI()`. The negative index is internal to CMC lookup-table construction; attacker influence is over reaching the CMC initialization path, not over the final `k - 1` value itself.

bug_description.original: A harmless out-of-bounds read occurs during UCS table building.
bug_description.normalized: The staged 64-byte witness is written to a temp file, loaded as a `VipsImage`, and then passed to `vips_jpegsave_buffer()`. During save preparation, `vips__foreign_convert_saveable()` requests a colourspace conversion, and `vips_colourspace_build()` derives a source interpretation that must be `VIPS_INTERPRETATION_CMC`, because the saved stack next dispatches `vips_CMC2LCh()` and that transform only appears on CMC routes. Constructing the first `vips_CMC2LCh` object in the fresh process runs one-time CMC table initialization and enters `make_hI()`. For the crashing `(j,i)` iteration, the search loop `for( k = 0; k < 360 && hl[j][k] <= i; k++ )` exits immediately with `k == 0`, so the interpolation on the next line reads `hl[j][k - 1]`, i.e. `hl[j][-1]`. Stage 01 reproduces `UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: runtime error: index -1 out of bounds for type 'float [361]'` at `libvips/colour/UCS2LCh.c:133:28`. The staged patch changes only the loop initializer from `k = 0` to `k = 1`, preventing the negative subscript when the first table entry already exceeds `i`.

source.value_from: Stage 01 saves the exact 64-byte `poc` to a temp file in `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput()` and then calls `test_one_file(name)`. This line is the first project statement that turns those bytes back into an image object.
source.note: This is the scored source rather than `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput()` because the harness entry only writes bytes to disk. The exact foreign loader that accepted the file is not preserved in Stage 01, but the saved stack proves this call returned non-NULL because execution reaches `vips_jpegsave_buffer()` at line 31 instead of returning at line 20.

tainted_value_origin.description: This statement materializes the source colourspace selector derived from the loaded image. On the witnessed path it resolves to `VIPS_INTERPRETATION_CMC`, which is what selects the conversion route that instantiates `vips_CMC2LCh` and reaches the buggy table builder.
tainted_value_origin.note: The exact loader/header field that produced `CMC` is not preserved in the saved runtime artifacts, but the downstream dispatch to `vips_CMC2LCh` is only possible when this guessed interpretation is CMC.

root_cause.description: The root cause is starting the search index `k` at `0` even though the following interpolation assumes both `k` and `k - 1` are valid table positions. When `hl[j][0] > i`, the loop exits immediately with `k == 0`.
root_cause.note: The staged patch changes this exact initializer to `k = 1`, guaranteeing the later `hl[j][k - 1]` and `hl[j][k]` reads stay within the 0..360 row bounds on the witnessed path.

sink.description: UBSan crash site. With `k == 0`, this interpolation reads `hl[j][k - 1]`, i.e. `hl[j][-1]`, before storing the derived `hI[j][i]` value.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports `UCS2LCh.c:133:28: runtime error: index -1 out of bounds for type 'float [361]'` in `make_hI` at this exact expression.

parser_admitted.description: A non-NULL return here proves the witness passed libvips format detection and image loading far enough to create a `VipsImage *`; otherwise `test_one_file()` would have returned before the save path.

fine_trace.note: Source. This call is the first project statement that materializes the staged witness into vulnerability-relevant state: a non-NULL `VipsImage *image`. The exact loader is not preserved in Stage 01, but the saved stack proves load succeeded because execution later reaches `vips_jpegsave_buffer()` instead of returning at line 20.

During JPEG save preparation, libvips decides the loaded image must be colour-converted rather than emitted as-is. The saved stack reaches line 1286, so this guard is satisfied on the witness; because JPEG's `bandfmt_jpeg` table always requests 8-bit output, the destination interpretation selected here is `VIPS_INTERPRETATION_sRGB`.

This statement materializes the source colourspace used for route selection. On the witnessed path it must resolve to `VIPS_INTERPRETATION_CMC`: the next dispatch constructs `vips_CMC2LCh`, and that transform only appears on route-table rows whose `from` space is CMC.

The first pipeline dispatch therefore constructs `VipsCMC2LCh`; its init immediately calls `vips_col_make_tables_CMC()` and, on first use in this fresh process, reaches `make_hI()` before any pixel processing.

fine_trace.note: Root cause. `make_hI()` iterates over precomputed row entries `hl[j][k]` while building the inverse hue table. On the crashing iteration, the only way to leave this loop with `k == 0` is that the first row entry already exceeds the current `i`, so starting at zero permits the later interpolation to use `k - 1 == -1`. The saved artifacts do not preserve the exact `(j,i)` pair; UBSan's `index -1` proves at least one iteration hit this state.

Sink. Because step 5 left `k == 0`, this interpolation evaluates `hl[j][k - 1]` as `hl[j][-1]` while computing `hI[j][i]`. Stage 01 reproduces `UCS2LCh.c:133:28: runtime error: index -1 out of bounds for type 'float [361]'` at this exact expression.

cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: control-only: attacker-controlled image state reaches the sink by selecting the CMC conversion/init path, while the faulting `k - 1` underflow is computed entirely inside table generation.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The staged patch edits the exact root-cause loop in `make_hI`, changing `for( k = 0; ... )` to `for( k = 1; ... )`. That preserves valid interpolation endpoints on the witnessed path. Stage 02 did not perform fixed-version dynamic validation.

poc.trigger: The staged `poc` is the exact 64-byte witness saved by Stage 01. `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput()` writes it to a temp file, `test_one_file()` loads that file with `vips_image_new_from_file()`, and `vips_jpegsave_buffer()` then reaches the CMC colourspace initialization path. The first `vips_CMC2LCh` construction enters `make_hI()` and crashes at `libvips/colour/UCS2LCh.c:133` when the interpolation reads `hl[j][-1]`.

format.name: opaque libvips-readable image file reaching CMC save path
format.contract: A file that `vips_image_new_from_file()` accepts as an image, that survives the small-image guard in `test_one_file()`, and that later causes `vips_image_guess_interpretation()` to yield `VIPS_INTERPRETATION_CMC` on the JPEG-save colourspace path. The staged evidence proves only this exact 64-byte witness and the resulting CMC-route state, not a broader external file-format family or value range.
